description: Bright adult animated explainer with expressive comedy, cinematic depth, literal visual storytelling, and deterministic text overlays.
visual_identity: rich cel shading with cinematic shadows and bright highlights
saturated cyan deep navy warm yellow orange coral red and cream palette
finished adult animated-show frame rather than an infographic
composition_rules: strong foreground midground and background depth
expressive character acting or an object grounded in a complete world
one strong visual beat readable in under one second
reserve clean negative space only for deterministic renderer overlays
camera_rules: alternate wide medium close-up object and comparison compositions
avoid three identical centered frames in a row
use object hero close-up when narration names an object
use low angle high angle extreme closeup over-shoulder diagonals and cropped foreground framing
no three consecutive frames with the same composition
background_rules: complete environment with no white outer border
support the focal subject without clutter
no poster floating on a page
object shots remain grounded in a cinematic environment with lighting and depth
positive_prompt_keywords: dramatic perspective and warm cool lighting contrast
clean controlled motion lines impact shapes and foreground action
negative_prompt_keywords: centered object on empty pastel background
